paragraphs.source_en: Kindaichi suddenly whistled shrilly and began briskly scratching his head this way and that. Chief Tachibana's eyes, too, became tense. "I see. Now it's even more certain that the man at the inn is connected with last night's murder. Mr. Kiyo, do you have any idea who he might be? A war buddy, for example, who might have come to look you up after returning to Japan? Or, say, someone who might hold a grudge against you?"
